Dialogs.Dialog: Hey, what are you up to？
Yeah. So, I need to get going.
I see, did I hold you up？
No, don't worry. See you later.
(She doesn't seem as hard to approach as everyone says...？)
Well, I guess I'll go home...
I was about to head home.
I see. Then want to walk together？
(I just can't do it right. What should I do...？)
Hey, can you help me with something？ Is that okay？
Eh？ You want me to？ ...Yes, if you think I can help.
Thanks. Like, in this kind of situation...
I see！ I think I get it.
(Never mind. I'll ask one of the seniors.)
(This club really livens up during breaks.)
(Huh, ▲高嶺＊＊▲ is spacing out alone again.)
Me... same as always, I guess.
▲主人公＊▲. Just going to the staff room for some class business.
I see, same as always. Need any help？
Thanks. But I'm doing this because I like it.
Come on, don't say that. Here.
Okay. Then I'll take you up on it.
Um, I have to go soon.
I'm supposed to be back in the classroom before the bell.
Um, weren't you on your way somewhere？ I shouldn't keep you, so I'll go.
I'm bored. Anything fun to do...
Oh, no. I'm keeping Mama waiting.
I see, then you'd better go.
Yes, sorry for stopping you. See you.
(Come to think of it, it's rare for ▲高嶺＊＊▲ to call out to me.)
▲主人公＊▲. Um, I'm picking up balls during break.
I see. All right, I'll help too.
▲主人公＊▲. Thank you. Um... did anything catch your eye while you watched？ Like my form...
I wouldn't know. ▲高嶺＊＊▲ is on a different level.
Is that so？ If you notice anything, tell me.
I see, thank you. I'll watch for that.
No problem at all. Don't worry about it！
Geez, you're such a smooth talker.
(Could it be she was off today...)
Oh right, there was something in the homework I didn't get...
Hey, sorry to bother you. There's something in the homework I don't get... Could you teach me？
Yes, sure. I hope I know it.
I see！ Got it, got it, you're a lifesaver.
(▲高嶺＊＊▲ is easier to talk to now.)
Um, Suzuki-sensei asked me to do something, but I don't think I can do it alone, so...
I see, then I'll help too. What do we do？
Thank you so much. Sorry for making you help.
It's fine, I had nothing to do anyway. See you.
Oh, sorry for keeping you standing here talking.
No, it's fine. Today turned into a good day.
You know, I was just thinking about you. And then there you really were. It surprised me.
Oh, sorry for keeping you standing here talking.
No, it's fine. I'm the one who stopped you. Besides...
I only caught a glimpse of you from far away. Hehe, I'm glad I followed you.
Oh, sorry for keeping you standing here talking.
Not at all. It was fun, so it's fine. See you.
Yes. You're working hard. How's it going？
I see. Then let's practice together.
I think I'm getting it. ▲高嶺＊＊▲ is good at teaching！
Hehe, you're just a quick learner.
Captain Tezuka... He really is good...
Hey, ▲高嶺＊＊▲. Captain Tezuka is so cool. I can't touch him.
That's not true. If anything, I think you...
Sorry, I messed up. Are you hurt？
I'm fine, it didn't hit me. It just surprised me a little.
(▲高嶺＊＊▲ has gotten so much brighter...)
No. I was just wondering how you were doing.
I have to go. I've gotten so chatty lately.
What are you doing here？ Oh, need something from me？
Yes. I thought I'd talk with you a bit.
Then you could've just come in.
That was fun. Can I come again？
I'm sorry too. Hehe, I came.
Were you running in the hall？
Just a little, because break is so short.
Oh, I have to get back. No running in the halls, okay？
(▲高嶺＊＊▲ has gotten so much brighter...)
Come on, no one's around... right？
Right？ ...No, not in a place like this.
Come on. No one's watching now... Okay？
Come on, no one's around... right？
Right？ ...No, right？ Not in a place like this.
Okay, that's it. Someone will see us.
Hey... Seems like it's just the two of us, huh？
Hey... Seems like it's just the two of us, huh？
Hey... Seems like it's just the two of us, huh？
Geez... So selfish！ Only until someone comes, okay？
That's totally a lie. It's over！
...This is school, you know？ That kind of thing isn't good.
It's not in the school rules, you know？
Geez, what does that even mean？
You're so bad. If we get caught, it's on you.
Bad！ Doing this at school. Think about what you did.
